implementation.preferences: src/theme.tsx; light, dark and system preferences; saved browser selection and cross-tab/system updates
implementation.firstPaint: public/theme-init.js, loaded synchronously in index.html before React and CSS; external script compatible with the existing self-only script policy
implementation.editor: src/CodingEditor.tsx; two Monaco themes without remounting the editor
implementation.accessibility: Focus indicators, skip link, labeled dialogs and room textareas, mobile drawer focus trap/inert background, Escape and focus restoration
implementation.motion: Short page/card/button/sidebar/dialog transitions; prefers-reduced-motion overrides; no theme-based route/editor remount

verification.result: PASS: client TypeScript, Vite production build, server TypeScript, 9 test files and 94 tests
verification.newTests: tests/theme.test.ts: actual first-paint bootstrap under explicit/system/blocked-storage conditions; actual light/dark text and semantic status token contrast at least 4.5:1
verification.desktop: Public account pages and all role-accessible routes across Company, HR and Candidate reviewed in light and dark modes, including report details, room preflight and coding workspace
verification.responsive: Desktop 1440, tablet 768 and mobile 390 CSS pixels; representative dashboards, jobs, applications, profiles, interviews, reports, settings and every public account route. No document-level horizontal overflow in 172 recorded observations.
interactionChecks: Theme choice survives navigation and reload
Mobile drawer traps keyboard focus; Escape returns focus to menu trigger
Modal Escape dismisses and returns focus to its opener
Notification Escape returns focus to the notification button
Code, undo history, unsaved answers and private notes survive theme changes
Search and unsaved signup fields survive theme changes
Loading, empty, success, disabled and error states use theme tokens
verification.dataIsolation: Authenticated browser checks used a separate ephemeral Mongo database and local test server. No QA accounts or fixtures were added to the normal application database.

limitations: Exact Hostinger template colors, fonts and layout could not be verified because the live previews failed to load. The result is reference-inspired.
Production build retains the existing large Monaco bundle warning (approximately 2.75 MB chunk).
Camera/microphone permissions, live multi-person WebRTC, external email/AI/speech/Judge0/TURN services and production deployment were not exercised by this UI review.
Reduced-motion behavior was reviewed in CSS; OS preference changes and cross-tab storage events were implemented but not separately browser-emulated.
Automated contrast checks cover shared token pairs, not every possible dynamic image or video background.

followUpReview.scope: Source accessibility, theme contrast, route inventory and current official reference discovery. Fresh browser evidence is recorded separately by the device/UI audit.

references.galleryListings: Official Hostinger galleries list 7Heven and both Amber variants. User selected Amber Video Editor.
references.webFetch: Both selected live previews returned errors; both gallery thumbnails returned cache-miss errors. No exact layout, font, or color match claimed from these failures.

browserFetch.result: Both selected official preview hosts failed in the browser with net::ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID.
browserFetch.conclusion: Exact 7Heven and Amber Video Editor appearance remains unverified; screenshots or theme configuration are needed.

routeInventory.changes: Current App/AuthPage route definitions match the recorded inventory.

completed: Authentication, jobs, interviews, and interviewer-directory filter buttons announce their selected state with aria-pressed inside named groups.
Shared Field controls have stable label and hint references. Existing custom labels and aria-describedby references are retained; hints no longer form part of the default control name.
Light-mode input borders changed from #b4aa9b to #918675: contrast improved from 2.02–2.29:1 to 3.15–3.58:1 across surface, canvas, and muted surfaces.
Existing dark-mode control borders and light/dark focus indicators satisfy 3:1 contrast on those surfaces.
Existing theme tests: 7 passed, including saved/system/blocked-storage first-paint resolution, 4.5:1 text/status contrast and 3:1 boundary/focus contrast.

browserReview.visualChecks: Structured candidate resume, light/dark mobile signup, evidence-based application review, job-creation modal, and interview preflight inspected. Screenshot evidence contains synthetic fixture accounts only.
interactions: Mobile navigation Shift+Tab remains trapped; Escape returns focus to Open navigation.
Application modal Escape returns focus to Review; notification Escape returns focus to Notifications.
Theme selection survives reload and route navigation; an unsaved project name survives theme switching.
Signup mode exposes aria-pressed. Password has a separate accessible name and described hint.
browserReview.qualification: Route observations include some loading and expected role-denied states; metrics are not a claim that every loaded page was visually inspected again in every theme and viewport. Earlier full route visual review remains separately dated. The first disposable server expired during a host suspension; the room was rechecked after restarting it.

pending: Exact 7Heven/Amber Video Editor appearance needs accessible live previews or user screenshots/theme configuration.
Cross-engine Safari/Firefox and physical mobile screen-reader checks are not established by source review or Chromium checks.
Contrast tests cover shared flat-surface tokens; they do not establish contrast over every dynamic image/video.
